title: Move deterministic key off the command line
lead: The CLI refuses an inline deterministic key, the same way ob-02 refused an inline passphrase, and reads the key from `--deterministic-key-file <path>` or `OBFUSCATOR_DETERMINISTIC_KEY`.
findings_note: Obfuscator.Cli/ObfuscatorCliProgram.cs ResolveDeterministicKey; --deterministic-key <secret> is visible in process lists like the removed --passphrase; scripts/test-local.sh and README examples use it
boundary: **Not in this slice:** a stdin source for the key; library API changes; key format or derivation changes.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `--deterministic-key <secret>` puts the key in argv, where other local users can read it from process lists, just as the removed `--passphrase` did. The docs only say "prefer" the environment variable, and `scripts/test-local.sh` still passes the key inline.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: Obfuscator.Cli/ObfuscatorCliProgram.cs; Obfuscator.Tests/ObfuscatorTests.cs; scripts/test-local.sh; README.md; Obfuscator.Cli/README.md; Obfuscator.Cli/PackageReadme.md.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `Cli_InlineDeterministicKey_IsRejectedWithoutEcho` (theory: `--deterministic-key <v>`, `--DETERMINISTIC-KEY <v>`, `--deterministic-key=<v>`) for obfuscate and deobfuscate: exit 1, the value never appears in stdout or stderr, the message names `OBFUSCATOR_DETERMINISTIC_KEY` and `--deterministic-key-file`, and no output is written.
- `Cli_DeterministicKeyFromFile_RoundTrips`: obfuscate with `--string-mode deterministic-token --deterministic-key-file <path>` (file ends with a newline) and deobfuscate with the same file restores the input.
- `Cli_DeterministicKeyFileFollowedByAnotherFlag_Fails`: `--deterministic-key-file` with no value reports "requires a value".
- `Cli_DocumentedOptions_AreAccepted` lists `--deterministic-key-file` instead of `--deterministic-key`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: In `ParseOptions`, reject `--deterministic-key` and `--deterministic-key=...` (case-insensitive) before the accepted-option check, without echoing a value, and name the alternatives. Remove `--deterministic-key` from the option sets and add `--deterministic-key-file` as a value option for obfuscate and deobfuscate. `ResolveDeterministicKey` reads the file first (trimming trailing CR/LF, as `ResolvePassphrase` does), then the environment variable. Update the usage text, the three READMEs, and `scripts/test-local.sh` (use the environment variable).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Run the new CLI tests and the full solution suite, then `scripts/test-local.sh`.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit for code, tests, docs, and script, plus the `.slicer/` changes. The library API (`ObfuscationOptions.DeterministicKey`, `DeobfuscateCsv(deterministicKey:)`) is unchanged.
